plan.title: Port framework:check-updates to the TypeScript engine

narratives.Description: task framework:check-updates is the last consumer-callable task that shells through uv run python run check-updates. Port the read-only remote-version probe (#801) to a native deft-ts verb and rewire tasks/framework.yml so consumer installs need zero Python for this surface.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Port cmd_check_updates / _run_remote_probe from run to packages/core; add packages/cli handler; register framework:check-updates alias; rewire tasks/framework.yml via engine:invoke; add vitest coverage; update coverage-map and CHANGELOG.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on a Python-free npm install, I want task framework:check-updates to probe upstream releases via deft only, so the check survives #1860 run deletion.

items.title: Given tasks/framework.yml check-updates, when invoked, then it routes through deft-ts with no uv run python or run shim.

narrative.Acceptance: Given tasks/framework.yml check-updates, when invoked, then it routes through deft-ts with no uv run python or run shim.

items.title: Given the TS check-updates verb, when probed with mocked git ls-remote, then OK/BEHIND/SKIPPED/NO-TAGS/ERROR statuses and --json output match the #801 contract.
